tips.text: Run Stage Defense on Steel Path; it pays more Heartstrings a rotation and clears faster.
Bring Mesa; her Regulators auto-target everything in the open arena, about 3 minutes a rotation.
Queue the Höllvania bounty version, not the plain node; the node runs nearly empty.
Skip the Resource Booster here; it does not raise Heartstrings.
Hildryn with Balefire, Nova or Protea also farm it well; Protea's turrets handle the flying enemies.
Bring a strong single-target weapon for the Scaldra Screamer on the last wave; its pulses nullify abilities.
Use Octavia or Nokko for a semi-AFK run.
Bring Protector Specters, Oberon or Gara if Flare keeps dying.
Finish The Hex quest and the Rank 4 standing and chemistry work first; the bounties feed both.
Budget another 390 Heartstrings for a second Temple if you want Pyrotechnics for Helminth.
Players call Temple one of the fastest recent frame farms; a full set is a few hours of Steel Path.
